title: US temple plot, school shooting: Gun epidemic spares no one as debate goes off target
content: A neo-Nazi teen attempted a mass shooting at a Hindu temple in Illinois, but his rifle jammed. The attack highlights ongoing debates about gun violence and societal issues, including parenting and mental health. Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi expressed horror that the attack targeted Indian Americans during worship. Many lawmakers condemned the incident, emphasizing the need to address religious and racial hatred in society.

title: Russia building 'security zone' in Ukraine that won't be part of future peace talks: Putin
content: Russian President Vladimir Putin announced the creation of a security zone within Ukraine to secure Russia's borders. He stated that his armed forces are successfully pushing Ukrainian troops beyond Russian territory. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov detailed that this buffer zone spans 660 km, with Russian control over 70 percent. The ongoing operation aims to ensure the necessary security for Russia, according to Peskov.

title: Bill Gates' daughters join mother to sign as founding backers of $100 million fund
content: Melinda French Gates, alongside her daughters, has joined a groundbreaking philanthropic venture designed to enhance women's health globally. The Women's Health Co-Lab aims to generate $100 million, supporting diverse organizations over three years. Phoebe Gates highlights the ongoing challenges women encounter in health and safety. With over $70 million already pledged by prominent philanthropists, the initiative is actively seeking more funding to meet its goal and broaden its reach.

title: Pennsylvania woman’s $250,000 family farm sale remains blocked after sibling dispute
content: Siblings are embroiled in a legal conflict over the fate of their family-owned 60-acre farm in Pennsylvania. A sister residing on the land sought to sell it despite having a long-term tenancy. In response, her siblings filed an urgent petition to block the sale, citing property rights. The Pennsylvania Superior Court supported the injunction, illustrating the complicated nature of co-ownership and informal familial arrangements in property disputes.

title: Rs 10,000 crore for small businesses: Who can benefit from India's new SME Growth Fund?
content: The Union Cabinet has greenlit a substantial Rs 10,000-crore SME Growth Fund dedicated to bolstering small and medium enterprises. This initiative focuses on equity investments in growth-driven manufacturing businesses that demonstrate strong viability and scalability. While the fund's launch is promising, the specifics of how to apply are still under wraps, making its successful impact contingent on the effective expansion of the chosen enterprises.

title: Return of Gulf oil: Has Iran lost grip on Hormuz & what does it mean for India?
content: The US war with Iran exposed Tehran’s ability to disrupt the global economy by blocking the Strait of Hormuz. Before the war, around 19 million barrels of crude oil were exported daily from the Middle East. However, September data from tanker-tracking firm Kpler showed oil flows recovering to an average of 16 million barrels per day, the highest since the conflict began.

title: Indianapolis removes 127-year-old dam to restore White River wildlife
content: The city of Indianapolis is set to dismantle the Emrichsville Dam as part of an initiative to revitalize the White River's natural flow. This endeavor is designed to improve aquatic habitats and ensure the safety of river goers. Funding has been obtained from a variety of federal and state organizations to assist with this project.

title: Court tells US to process Green Card applications for up to 55k people
content: A federal judge has ordered the reopening of the diversity visa lottery for 2027, allowing 55,000 applicants. The ruling came after a lawsuit filed against Secretary of State Marco Rubio regarding the lottery's registration. Judge Jinsook Ohta mandated a 30-day registration period for submissions, which must meet eligibility requirements. Additionally, new policy changes require some applicants to return to their home countries for Green Card processing.

title: 6,000 cops, 2 notices, Dipke among 150 detained: How unrest unfolded in central Delhi
content: A protest march called 'Lehra Do Tiranga' saw widespread detentions by Delhi Police in Connaught Place. The event protested against the detention of Cockroach Janta Party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. Authorities restricted gatherings at Central Park due to a lack of official permission for the march. Parallel protests occurred near Mandi House, where demands for the resignation of Gyanesh Kumar arose.

title: Ryan Clark challenges Stephen A. Smith over Lane Johnson’s retirement
content: Ryan Clark defended Lane Johnson after Stephen A. Smith questioned the Eagles tackle’s retirement and mental health reasons. Clark said the impact of someone’s words matters more than their intentions. Johnson retired on October 6 after 14 seasons with Philadelphia, explaining that his mental health and family priorities had changed and he needed to step away from football.

title: Dolph Ziggler’s net worth in 2026: How did Nic Nemeth build his fortune?
content: Dolph Ziggler, also known as Nic Nemeth, transitioned from WWE to independent wrestling promotions in 2023. He is recognized for his significant contributions, achieving multiple championships over his two-decade career. Nemeth has pursued stand-up comedy alongside his wrestling endeavors, performing regularly at various venues. His career includes notable television appearances and participation in movie projects. Following his release from WWE, he has remained active in the wrestling community worldwide.

title: No Jadeja, Iyer to lead in last two ODIs: Check full Test and ODI squads vs NZ

Fast bowlers Akash Deep and Anshul Kamboj have returned to the Test squad. Shubman Gill will lead India in the first three ODIs, while Shreyas Iyer will captain the team in the last two matches.

title: Two vessels carrying 24 Indian seafarers hit by projectiles, drone in separate incidents
content: Union shipping minister Sarbananda Sonowal confirmed that two vessels carrying Indian seafarers were attacked in October. The MT ST 3 was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, while the YARA J was hit by a drone off Romania. Fortunately, all 24 Indian nationals aboard both vessels are reported safe and unharmed. India has condemned attacks on commercial vessels, citing concerns for the safety of seafarers.

title: Curtains for Ravindra Jadeja in ODIs? All-rounder drops out of 2027 World Cup plans
content: Since the 2023 ODI World Cup, Ravindra Jadeja has featured in only 15 of the 32 ODIs India have played. In his last eight matches, he has picked up just three wickets at an economy rate of over six. Captain Shubman Gill has maintained that Jadeja was not dropped for the third ODI, but the 37-year-old is now fourth in the pecking order among India’s bowling all-rounders, behind Axar Patel, Washington Sundar and Harsh Dubey.

title: Why BCCI named two captains for India's New Zealand ODI series
content: India will have two captains during the five-match ODI series against New Zealand. Shubman Gill will lead the team in the first three matches, while Shreyas Iyer will take over for the final two games.

title: Oh(io) No: Vivek Ramaswamy's Catch-22 problem with MAGA

title: Zubeen Garg death case: Gauhati HC grants bail to suspended DSP Sandipon Garg
content: The Gauhati High Court has granted bail to Sandipon Garg, the suspended Assam Police DSP, linked to the controversial death of his cousin, Zubeen Garg. Arrested by the Special Investigation Team, Sandipon follows Amritprava Mahanta, the first accused, who also received bail. Additionally, the Supreme Court emphasized the need for an expedited trial for festival organizer Shyamkanu Mahanta amidst discussions on the nature of Zubeen's death—accidental or conspiratorial.

title: Zelenskyy slams Trump's diesel deal, says will help fund Putin’s war in Ukraine

He warned that this agreement could provide additional funds for Russia's ongoing war against Ukraine. Zelenskyy emphasized the need for Europe to increase support to Ukraine as missile attacks continue. The president requested significant financial assistance to maintain Ukraine's defense against Russian aggression.

title: SIR protests: Opposition has found common ground. But can it stay united?

Following arrests of CJP leaders, Rahul Gandhi showed solidarity, signaling a possible shift in strategy. Previously, Congress and CJP had organized separate protests over electoral issues, but they now seem to be collaborating more closely.

title: Putin, Trump to announce several joint projects as Russian diesel returns to market

Discussions reportedly include collaborative data centre projects powered by Russian nuclear energy. Supplies of diesel have begun reaching international markets following the deal with the United States. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has criticized the arrangement, expressing concerns about its implications for energy revenue.

title: Russian officer helped Ukraine kill over 300 troops by leaking military secrets
content: Russian army lieutenant Lev Stupnikov took a perilous stand against his own military by secretly supplying Ukrainian forces with critical intelligence. His actions led to the targeted elimination of more than 300 Russian soldiers and deliberate sabotage of weapons systems, culminating in his flight to the Russian Volunteer Corps as a direct challenge to Putin's leadership. Stupnikov’s bravery reshaped the landscape of the ongoing Ukraine conflict.

title: Shubman Gill returns to Ranji Trophy, set to play Punjab's next match

Gill missed the opening match against Assam, which was led by Uday Saharan. Recently, Gill was honored as the ICC Men's Player of the Month for the fifth time.

title: Oprah Winfrey’s $12m gift still supports Smithsonian theatre 13 years later

Her financial support was instrumental in the museum's fundraising efforts, culminating in the naming of the Oprah Winfrey Theater. This theater serves as a vital space for public events, fostering discussions surrounding African American history and cultural narratives.

title: India flags trade concerns, market access barriers; China reacts

Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted India's challenges in accessing the Chinese market for its products. The trade deficit with China widened significantly, reaching $105.93 billion in the first nine months of the year. India is striving to improve bilateral trade ties with China through negotiations and ongoing discussions.

title: 'We'll knock it out fast': Trump may target Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear facility

He stated that nuclear weapons would not be necessary for achieving US objectives in the situation. The remarks followed ongoing US-Israeli strikes against Iran since February, amid rising tensions. Iran's foreign ministry denied any nuclear activity at the site, labeling US threats as baseless.

The victim's family, having sought justice tirelessly, welcomed the verdict.

title: Jeremy Renner bought LA mansion for $7m, transformed it and sold for $24m
content: Jeremy Renner and Kristoffer Winters transformed a 1920s mansion into an expansive, design-led estate . the property, known as The Reserve, was originally acquired by the pair in 2010 for $7 million . three years later, their transformation of the estate had resulted in a 10,005-square-foot residence that eventually attracted British luxury property developer Nick Candy .

title: Indian charged in US for illegally voting in 2024 polls; faces up to 10 yrs in jail
content: mukeshkumar Somabhai Chaudhari was indicted by a federal grand jury in Minnesota on two counts linked to the alleged offence . the indictment accuses him of knowingly claiming US citizenship to cast a ballot . he signed a voter signature certificate on November 5, 2024, as required under Minnesota law to vote in the general election .
